description: Na₈Mg(CoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.75 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.75 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.38 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.56 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.72 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.81 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.73 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.51 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.95 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.96 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form corner-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Co atom to form corner-sharing ONa₄Co trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-69°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom.
